publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We evaluate, for the first time, the achievable spectral efficiency of periodic nonlinear Fourier transform based communication systems with hard decision FEC and modulated perturbed plane waves with high order QAM formats, e.g 32QAM-512QAM.

articleTitle: Calibration of in-phase/quadrature amplitude and phase response imbalance for coherent receiver
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an In-phase/Quadrature imbalance calibration method which only uses the transceiver itself for coherent receiver. Experiment shows that IQ skew calibration accuracy reaches 0.2 ps and the method is robust to many practical imperfections.

articleTitle: A simplified dual-carrier DP-64QAM 1 Tb/s transceiver
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A 1 Tb/s net bitrate transceiver using a low complexity dual-carrier architecture with free running lasers and DP-64QAM, enabled by pilot-aided DSP and low-rate LDPC, is shown to achieve transmission over 400 km with 100 km amplifier spacing.

articleTitle: Techniques for highly linear radio-over-fiber links
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Hybrid fiber-wireless systems offer the promise of efficient high capacity fiber class data delivery to mobile and fixed wireless devices. Achieving this promise will require systems employing highly linear techniques.

articleTitle: Trans-Atlantic field trial using probabilistically shaped 64-QAM at high spectral efficiencies and single-carrier real-time 250-Gb/s 16-QAM
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We transmitted probabilistically shaped 64-QAM at 7.46 b/s/Hz over a 5,523-km inservice EDFA-only amplified trans-Atlantic cable (5.68 b/s/Hz over a looped-back 11,046 km). Using real-time processing we achieve single-carrier 250-Gb/s 16-QAM at 4 b/s/Hz.

articleTitle: Modified digital backpropagation accounting for polarization-mode dispersion
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a modified DBP algorithm accounting for PMD. The accumulated PMD at the receiver is factorized into several PMD sections, and inserted into the DBP routine to distributively compensate for PMD, outperforming the conventional approach by 1.1 dB in SNR.

articleTitle: Service chaining in multi-layer networks using segment routing and extended BGP FlowSpec
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Effective service chaining enforcement along TE paths is proposed using Segment Routing and extended BGP Flowspec for micro-flows mapping. The proposed solution is experimentally evaluated with a deep packet inspection service supporting dynamic flow enforcement.

articleTitle: First 400GBASE-LR8 interoperability using CFP8 modules
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate interoperability of 400GBASE-LR8 for the first time between different modules suppliers and test sets using CFP8 alpha production pluggable modules. Error-free operation was measured with 10km of fiber and additional attenuation.

articleTitle: TDM based optical bypass for intra-rack elephant flow with a DPDK based online timeslot allocator
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An optical TDM system is experimentally demonstrated with sFlow based elephant flow detection and a DPDK based online timeslot allocator. With proposed timeslot allocation algorithm, allocator could have 383 Gbps throughput and continuous timeslots allocation.

articleTitle: A polymer waveguide material optimized for on-board optical links and Si photonic interfaces
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report on a polymer optical waveguide material with 0.29 dB/cm loss at 1550nm, wide spectral window of transparency, environmental stability, and solder-reflow compatibility. Flexible ribbons are sufficiently robust for standard high-throughput microelectronics assembly.

articleTitle: 60-Micrometer pitch polymer waveguide array attached active optical flex
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a 60-micrometer pitch polymer waveguide array attached active optical flexible module which is useful for compact and high-channel count optical interconnect. We fabricated this module and realized 20-Gbps optical signal transmission.

articleTitle: Silicon 1 × 2 mode- and polarization-selective switch
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an on-chip silicon 1×2 switch that routes 8 data channels on 4 modes and 2 polarizations. The insertion losses are <; 8dB, and the crosstalk values are below -15dB. The 8 channels are tested with a 72-Gb/s signal.

articleTitle: C- to L-band wavelength conversion enabled by parametric processes in a few mode fiber
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate the potential for all-optical wavelength conversion within and between the C- and L-bands using inter-modal four-wave-mixing processes among different phase-matched and dispersion-tailored spatial modes in a single elliptical-core few mode fiber.

articleTitle: Compact and low cost superimposition of AMCC with magneto-optic VOA
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We have proposed optical superimposition scheme employing a magneto-optic VOA as a simple and low cost implementation of AMCC system and experimentally confirmed lower power penalty in AMCC superimposition.

articleTitle: Inverse-designed ultra-compact star-crossings based on PhC-like subwavelength structures
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Inverse-designed star-crossings with 8 and 10 ports are proposed, with ultra-short coupling lengths of 5.28μm and 5.4μm respectively. Their measured ILs are less than 1.6dB and 2.4dB respectively over 60nm bandwidth centered 1550nm wavelength.

articleTitle: Modulation optimization for D-band wireless transmission link
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: High-performance high-frequency mm-wave amplifier and other components, particularly those at D-band, are difficult to manufacture. We optimize modulation format for one 150-GHz D-band vector-mm-wave system and demonstrate OFDM can better tolerate imperfect-gain-characteristic of D-band amplifier.

articleTitle: Joint estimation of time-frequency impairments for single carrier coherent transmission system with FrFT tailored training symbol
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A training symbol exploiting time-frequency properties of FrFT is proposed and experimentally demonstrated to simultaneously achieve high performance frame timing synchronization, frequency offset and chromatic dispersion estimation for single carrier 28Gbaud DP-QPSK coherent transmission system.

articleTitle: Phosphate glass fibers for optical amplifiers and biomedical applications
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Phosphate glass optical fibers were designed and fabricated for applications in the fields of remote sensing and biomedicine. Main results are reported together with the recent developments.

articleTitle: Single-carrier 400G based on 84-GBaud PDM-8QAM transmission over 2,125 km SSMF enhanced by pre-equalization, LUT and DBP
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Single-carrier 400G based on 84-GBaud 8QAM is generated and pre-processed with pre-equalization and Look-up-Table pre-distortion. Thanks to the receiver-side DBP fiber nonlinearity compensation, 8×400G transmission over 2,125 km SSMF with EDFA-only amplification is enabled.

articleTitle: 800 Gbit/s dual channel transmitter with 1.056 Tbit/s gross rate
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate generation of a 44 Gbaud 64 QAM dual polarization dual channel signal from one laser achieving a gross rate of 1.056 Tbit/s. Fiber transmission reach of 730 km over SSMF is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Full C-band tunable MEMS-VCSEL for next generation G.metro mobile front- and backhauling
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report full C-band tunable, 10 Gbit/s capability, directly modulated MEMS-VCSEL for next generation converged mobile fronthaul and backhaul applications. Bit error rates below 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−9</sup> were achieved over up to 40 km SSMF.

articleTitle: Demonstration of reconfigurable WDM multicast supporting content replication and protection switching for content delivery optical network
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a reconfigurable WDM multicast scheme supporting content replication and protection switching for CDON through SOA and our LCoS-based TB-WSS. One-to-six/seven/eight 25 Gb/s QPSK WDM multicasts also with protection switching function have been successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Double slot fiber-to-chip coupler using direct strip-slot mode coupling
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a fiber-to-chip coupler using asymmetric double slot waveguide and direct strip-slot mode coupling to shorten a transition while maintaining high coupling efficiency. Experimental result shows 1.8 dB insertion loss with a broad bandwidth.

articleTitle: Network fault protection performance enhancement by using elastic optical path
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The challenges of enhancing protection performance by improving the spectral efficiency of elastic optical networks are studied. Novel optical filter configuration, signal equalization, and spectral bandwidth assignment technologies are shown to reduce the guard band.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of flexible regeneration and modulation conversion in elastic optical networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We study potential performance gains resulting from deliberate use of signal regeneration along with modulation conversion in translucent elastic optical networks (EONs) realizing super-channel transmission.

articleTitle: Tailoring nonlinear frequency generation in graded-index multimode fibers
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate that frequency generation in multimode graded-index fibers can be tailored through appropriate fiber design. This is achieved by exploiting a geometric parametric instability which can be utilized for developing novel fiber light sources.

articleTitle: Application of multicore optical fibers in astronomy
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Multicore fibers are gaining growing attention in astronomy. The two main attributes which make them attractive for astronomy are that they reduce the distance between cores and hence have a superior fill factor to other approaches and they offer the possibility to transport light in many channels with the overhead of only having to handle a single fiber. These properties are being exploited to realize miniature integral field units that can transport light from different regions in a focal plane to a spectrograph for example. Here we offer an overview of several applications where multicore fibers are now being considered and applied to astronomical observations to enhance scientific yield.

articleTitle: 20dB net-gain fiber optical parametric amplification of 18×120Gb/s polarization-multiplexed signals
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the amplification and characterization of 18×120Gb/s (2.16Tb/s) polarization-division multiplexed WDM signals using a polarization-insensitive single-pump FOPA, whilst achieving fiber-to-fiber net signal gains of 10-20dB over >2THz gain bandwidth.

articleTitle: 112 Gb/s/λ WDM direct-detection Nyquist-SCM transmission at 3.15 (b/s)/Hz over 240 km SSMF enabled by novel beating interference compensation
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 112Gb/s/channel 35GHz-spaced WDM direct-detection SSB Nyquist-SCM transmission over a record distance of 240km SSMF using a novel beating interference compensation method, which offers a 7.6dB required OSNR improvement, and 200% reach enhancement.

articleTitle: End-to-end SDN/NFV orchestration of video analytics using edge and cloud computing over programmable optical networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper proposes the introduction of SDN-enabled containers to support the deployment of SDN/NFV applications located at the network edge, which are able to trigger on-demand connectivity services. A video analytics use case is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Low-complexity chromatic dispersion equalizer for 400G transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a reduced complexity time-domain CD equalizer in a dual-carrier 400G PM-16QAM system, yielding hardware savings of over 99% in terms of multipliers, and a latency reduction of ∼80% over standard frequency-domain CD equalization.

articleTitle: MEMS tunable hybrid plasmonic-Si waveguide
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A MEMS tunable hybrid plasmonic-Si (HP) waveguide is investigated, showing very large changes of both effective refractive index and propagation loss when applying bias voltage. Preliminary experimental results show that: with 15μm MEMS structure in Si waveguide platform, the extinction ratio can be over 20dB between "on" and "off states.

articleTitle: Extreme speed power-DAC: Leveraging InP DHBT for ultimate capacity single-carrier optical transmissions
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: With 100-GBd operation and 4-V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pp_diff</sub> swing, InP DHBT Power-DAC enabled experiments with different types of E/O modulators. Single-carrier 100-GBd PAM-4 IM/DD transceiver for datacenters and 1.08 Tb/s transmitter (90-GBd PDM-64QAM) were demonstrated.

articleTitle: Real-time demonstration of over 20Gbps V- and W-band wireless transmission capacity in one OFDM-RoF system
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: With real-time reception, we experimentally demonstrate the generation and wireless delivery of V-band (57-GHz) and W-band (91-GHz) OFDM-16QAM signals, both with 6.02-GHz-bandwidth (24.08-Gb/s net bit rate) and a BER below the SD-FEC threshold of 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>.

articleTitle: On efficient incentive-driven VNF service chain provisioning with mixed-strategy gaming in broker-based EO-IDCNs
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose to realize incentive-driven virtual network function service chain provisioning in broker-based elastic optical inter-datacenter networks with mixed-strategy gaming and design a heuristic to find the near-equilibrium solutions. Simulation results verify both the effectiveness and stability of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Mixed channel traffic grooming in shared backup path protected IP over elastic optical network
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: For mixed channel traffic grooming in shared backup path protected IP over elastic optical network, we develop an auxiliary graph based heuristic algorithm allowing working and protection traffic flows to share common optical channels. Results show that the scheme is efficient in greatly improving capacity and transponder utilization.

articleTitle: Continuously tunable optical frequency shift of 1.6-Tb/s superchannel up to THz-range by polarization switched frequency conversion
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a continuously tunable optical frequency shifter which allows to choose any shift-frequency including fractions of the original signal bandwidth. A 1.6-Tb/s PDM-16QAM superchannel is arbitrarily frequency-shifted within THz-range during a 200-km error-free transmission.

articleTitle: One chip, PLC three-mode exchanger based on symmetric and asymmetric directional couplers with integrated mode rotator
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A three-mode exchanger composed of symmetric and asymmetric directional couplers is proposed for mode-division-multiplexing system. Theoretical design shows low-loss and highly efficient mode exchanging is possible. Fabricated device exhibits successful mode exchanging for LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> mode.

articleTitle: Silicon photonic switch subsystem with 900 monolithically integrated calibration photodiodes and 64-fiber package
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Monolithic germanium photodiodes on every cell calibrate a 32×32 silicon photonic switch of 448 Mach-Zehnders in 10 minutes. 64 fibers permanently attached through a waveguide concentrator in a wire-bonded BGA achieve 2.9dB C-band TE fiber-to-die.

articleTitle: Optical quantization based on intensity to frequency conversion using frequency chirp in a QD-SOA
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a novel optical quantization technique based on intensity-to-frequency conversion using frequency chirp in a quantum-dot semiconductor optical amplifier. A four-level signal at 10-GSamples/s is successfully achieved for photonic analog-to-digital conversions.

articleTitle: Fast parallel lightpath re-optimization for crosstalk reduction in multi-core fiber networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel SDN-based parallel lightpath re-optimization mechanism enabled by high-precision time synchronization for crosstalk reduction in multi-core fiber networks. Experimental and simulation results show that the proposed mechanism can significantly reduce re-optimization time.

articleTitle: Passive waveguide device technologies — Building block of functionality and integration
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Any function can be realized by passive waveguide devices, without emission and detection. Appropriate selection of device structure and material is needed, because optical functional devices are not the digital circuit but analogue devices. Integration is a natural consequence of the requirements of functionality, less connection points, compactness and stabilization. Appropriate selection of building blocks and technology is needed, together with a new approach and material (silicon photonics, InP-based photonics or something else?).

articleTitle: Frequency noise of a normal dispersion microresonator-based frequency comb
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using delayed self-heterodyne coherent detection, we characterized the FM noise across the C-band of a widely spaced microresonator-based frequency comb. The resulting linewidth depends on both the pump laser and the comb line position.

articleTitle: 10 Tb/s self-homodyne 64-QAM superchannel transmission with 4% spectral overhead
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We use a 10 nm frequency comb to transmit a 10 Tb/s 50×20 GBaud PM-64QAM super-channel over 80 km SMF. Using two unmodulated carriers we regenerate a phase locked receiver comb, enabling self-homodyne detection with record-low spectral overhead.

articleTitle: Does it make sense to put optics in both the front and backplane of a large data-center?
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a dual optical architecture, with optics in both the front plane (connecting servers within a rack) and in the backplane (connecting TOR switches). The architecture is shown to scale to a million servers.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of single carrier 400G/500G in 50-GHz grid for 1000-km transmission
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this paper, we experimentally demonstrated 400G/500G single-carrier in 50-GHz grid for 1000-km G.654 fiber transmission with Raman amplifier. 43.125-Gbaud PDM-64QAM (400G net) and PDM-128QAM (500G net) achieved spectral efficiency of 8 and 10 bit/s/Hz.

articleTitle: Dynamic placement of baseband processing in 5G WDM-based aggregation networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and compare different baseband-processing-placement strategies in optical aggregation networks. Proper trade-off between baseband-resources consolidation and network blocking can be obtained by dynamically adapting location of processing resources to traffic conditions.

articleTitle: All-optical signal upconversion using optically-injected DFB laser and embedded optoelectronic oscillator for radio-over-fiber applications
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose all-optical signal upconversion scheme using optically-injected DFB in combine with embedded optoelectronics oscillator for RoF application. The low-noise LO provided by OEO and near-SSB modulation implemented by injection locking enables high-performance in transmission.

articleTitle: Routing and regenerator planning in a carrier's core ROADM network
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optimizing routing and regenerator planning in a carrier's inter-city ROADM network provides significant savings. We describe how regenerator site planning and regenerator pre-deployment can be optimized for an inter-city IP over optical network.

articleTitle: 56 Gb/s electro-absorption modulation of a heterogeneously integrated InP-on-Si DFB laser diode
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Electro-absorption modulation of a heterogeneously integrated InP/Si DFB laser is demonstrated by reverse biasing the InP tapers, used to couple the light between the InP and the Si waveguides. Modulation at 56 Gb/s is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Laser fabrications of multi-layer waveguide arrays in multi-core fibers and glass panels for optical interconnect
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper discuss ultrafast laser fabrication of 3D lightwave circuits in optical fibers and glass substrates for optical interconnects. The interaction between embedded waveguides and surface optical structures produced by semiconductor microfabrication will be discussed.

articleTitle: Comparison of multimode fiber modal bandwidth metrics
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We describe a multimode fiber bandwidth metric significantly more strongly correlated to link inter-symbol interference (ISI) penalties than conventional metrics. The improvement is demonstrated in plots of ISI vs. bandwidth for various link lengths.

articleTitle: A capacity analysis for space division multiplexing optical networks with MIMO equalization
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We analyze the capacity of SDM networks under limited DSP complexities. Results show that DSP complexity limitations can severely restrict the network capacity enhancement brought by adding spatial channels, especially for large-scale networks.

articleTitle: Distributed and discriminative Brillouin optical fiber sensing based on heterogeneous multicore fiber
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We characterized Brillouin scattering in heterogeneous multicore fiber (H-MCF), and unveil new perspective for distributed sensing using H-MCF based spatial-division multiplexing, in which discriminative measurement is achieved and bending induced uncertainty has been eliminated.

articleTitle: Second-order few-mode distributed Raman amplifier for mode-division multiplexing transmission
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We first experimentally demonstrate a second-order few-mode distributed Raman amplifier with 4 dB mode-equalized gain. The noise figure improvement of the LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> and LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> modes are respectively 1.1 dB and 0.9 dB compared with first-order Raman amplification scheme.

articleTitle: 4 Bits/symbol phase and amplitude modulation on a single discrete eigenvalue for transmissions based on nonlinear fourier transform
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated and compared various 4 bits/symbol phase and amplitude modulation formats on a single discrete eigenvalue. 4G Baud with total bit rate 16 Gb/s transmission over 750 km is achieved.

articleTitle: Nonlinear mitigation using probabilistically shaped real-valued modulation formats
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate probabilistically-shaped modulation formats with increased spectral efficiency and nonlinear mitigation capabilities compared to phase-conjugated twin-waves QPSK at 54.2 Gbaud, yielding 21 % increased reach.

articleTitle: Capacity enhancement for hybrid fiber-wireless channels with 46.8Gbit/s wireless multi-CAP transmission over 50m at W-band
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Transmission of a 46.8 Gbit/s multi-band cap signal is experimentally demonstrated over a 50 m W-band radio-over-fiber link. Bit error rates below 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> are achieved, employing nine cap bands with bit and power loading.

articleTitle: 32QAM WDM transmission using a quantum-dash passively mode-locked laser with resonant feedback
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate coherent WDM transmission using a quantum-dash mode-locked laser diode with resonant feedback. We report a line rate of 12 Tbit/s (32QAM 60×20 GBd PDM) over 75 km SMF. The spectral efficiency is 7.5 bit/s/Hz.

articleTitle: How much transport grooming is needed in the age of flexible clients?
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We analyze the impact of flexible client interfaces in the client- and line-side requirements of optical transport scenarios. The simulation results identify the network conditions where transport grooming fabrics are a necessary complement to flexibility on the client-side.

articleTitle: Integrated ferroelectric plasmonic optical modulator
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An integrated ferroelectric plasmonic Mach-Zehnder modulator is demonstrated to work in a direct-detection setup with a 72 Gbit/s NRZ modulation format. The device works reliably beyond 130°C with an extinction ratio beyond 15 dB.

articleTitle: Adiabatic chirp impact on the OSNR sensitivity of complex direct modulation: An experiment investigation
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We study the adiabatic chirp impact on the complex direct modulation using polarization-multiplexed PAM-4 system by varying signal baud-rate with data-rate up to 120 Gb/s. Experiment shows insufficient chirp at 30-Gbaud degrades >4 dB OSNR sensitivity compared with 10-Gbaud.

articleTitle: 90° Optical hybrid front-end circuit fabricated by 3D direct laser inscription
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show the fabrication of a 90° optical hybrid front-end circuit by direct laser inscription. Excess loss of 1.4 dB with maximum phase error of 3.6 degrees were achieved using MMI-based devices and a novel 3-dimensional layout.

articleTitle: Switching devices and systems enabled by advanced planar lightwave circuits
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review our recent achievements on the development of a multicast switch (MCS) based on a high-Δ planar lightwave circuit (PLC). We present compact and low-loss MCS which consists of ZrO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> PLC.

articleTitle: Mode-evolution-based, broadband 1×2 port high-pass/low-pass filter for silicon photonics
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate integrated, mode-evolution-based, 1×2 port high-pass/low-pass filters in a silicon photonics platform that can simultaneously achieve broadband operation, single cutoff wavelength, and a record high filter roll-off of 2.5 dB/nm for the first time.

articleTitle: QoT aware adaptive elastic optical networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Operating Elastic Optical Networks with low margins increases their efficiency but suffers from soft-failures, rendering the QoT of lightpaths unacceptable. We present a toolkit that leverages the flexibility dimensions to survive against QoT problems.

articleTitle: Amplitude noise suppression and orthogonal multiplexing using injection-locked single-mode VCSEL
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate BER reduction and orthogonal modulation using an injection locked single-mode VCSEL. It allows us suppressing an amplitude noise of optical signal and/or double the capacity of an information channel.

articleTitle: Optimal design of Ge-dot photoMOSFETs for highly-integrated monolithic Si photonics
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Ge-dot/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/SiGe-channel photoMOSFETs are demonstrated on Si substrate. A decrease in the dot size and gate oxide thickness significantly enhances the photoresponsivity (9000A/W) with 6nW under 850nm illumination, and improves response time (0.48ns) and power consumption.

articleTitle: WDM transmission using quantum-dash mode-locked laser diodes as multi-wavelength source and local oscillator
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate coherent WDM transmission using a pair of quantum-dash mode-locked laser-diodes - one to generate a multitude of optical carriers, and another to generate a multitude of LO tones. We transmit a line rate of 4 Tbit/s (23×45 GBd PDM-QPSK) over 75 km.

articleTitle: 50-Gb/s PDM-DMT-SSB transmission over 40km SSMF using a single photodetector in C-band
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated transmission of 50-Gb/s PDM-DMT-SSB signal over 40km SSMF in C-band using a single photodetector. The DMT signal in another polarization is placed at the guard band of the SSB-OFDM signal.

articleTitle: 504 and 462 Gb/s direct detect transceiver for single carrier short-reach data center applications
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a single carrier direct detect transceiver operating at 84 Gsymbols/s providing 5.5 and 6 bits per symbol delivering 462 and 504 Gb/s employing a novel modulation format and DSP for 400+ GbE PMD.

articleTitle: Emulation of a 16×16 optical switch using cascaded 4×4 dilated hybrid MZI-SOA optical switches
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first cascaded operation of integrated 4×4 hybrid MZI-SOA optical switches. Experimental studies emulate a 16×16 hybrid switch with 15dB IPDR for 1dB penalty and 43% reduced power consumption than equivalent SOA-based switches.

articleTitle: Ge0.9Sn0.1 multiple-quantum-well p-i-n photodiodes for optical communications at 2 μm
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a Ge<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.9</sub>Sn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</sub> multiple-quantum-well p-i-n photodiode on Si substrate with a cutoff wavelength beyond 2 μm. A record-low dark current density of 31 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">bias</sub> = -1V is achieved.

articleTitle: Metro transport, from mesh to hub
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We discuss the realistic challenges of network operation and new services for carriers' metro transport networks. A new metro transport architecture is proposed and evaluated.

articleTitle: Novel detection in V-band MIMO OFDM RoF systems using ADCs with sub-Nyquist sampling
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel detection scheme in MIMO-OFDM-RoF systems is proposed. Via preprocessing, data are received using sub-Nyquist-sampling ADCs without MIMO demodulation and extra DSP. Based on 5/32-GSample/s sampling rate, 50-Gbps 2 × 2 MIMO-OFDM-RoF transmission was successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Experimental assessment of degradation-triggered reconfiguration in optically interconnected cloud-RAN
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: C-RAN control architecture is proposed and experimentally assessed. A local controller in each location receives latency, jitter, and BER monitoring data from local BBUs and detects a CPRI degradation, which triggers a mobile network reconfiguration.

articleTitle: Cascading of tenant SDN and cloud controllers for 5G network slicing using transport API and openstack API
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Cascading of network and cloud resources is defined as the recursive hierarchical abstraction and virtualization of resources. Cascading is expected to an enabler for 5G Network Slicing. We provide a demonstration of the proposed concept.

articleTitle: Network utilization improvement using format-agnostic multi-channel wavelength converters
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the effectiveness of multi-channel, format-agnostic, all-optical wavelength converters (AO-WCs) in improving network utilization. Simulations show doubled network utilization with significantly fewer AO-WCs and experiments confirm successful multi­channel conversions over full operating wavelength range.

articleTitle: 28-Gbit/s 80-km transmission using SOA-assisted extended-reach EADFB laser (AXEL)
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We fabricated 1.3-pm AXELs to extend the transmission distance with 28-Gbit/s-NRZ signal. SOA-assisted gain is effective in increasing the average output power. We successfully demonstrated 80-km transmission with an APD-ROSA.

articleTitle: Millimeter-wave radio bundling for reliable transmission in multi-section fiber-wireless mobile fronthaul
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a reconfigurable millimeter-wave radio bundling method to improve system efficiency and transmission reliability in multi-section fiber-wireless mobile fronthaul. A multi-point multi-section experiment demonstrates improved signal quality and reliability.

articleTitle: Holding-time information (HTI): When to use it?
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The known technique of HTI-aware routing can be used for connection admission, or spectrum defragmentation. We show that HTI used for defragmentation is the most beneficial in reducing blocking in space-division multiplexed elastic optical networks.

articleTitle: Optical amplifier based on a 7-core fiber for telecommunication satellite purposes
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a 7-core radiation hardened optical fiber amplifier for application in telecommunication satellites. The amplifier is part of a solution that aims to overcome bottleneck problems associated with satellites, such as size and weight reduction together with information capacity growth.

articleTitle: Cost-efficient multi-layer restoration to address IP router outages in IP-over-EONs
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We study how to address the IP router outages in an IP-over-EON with multi-layer restoration (MLR), and propose an auxiliary-graph (AG) based scheme that can minimize the additional OPEX of MLR with the help of the spectrum expansion capability of sliceable bandwidth-variable transponders (SBV-Ts).

articleTitle: Demonstration of a FPGA-based CPRI-over-ethernet real-time system achieving 120 Gb/s throughput over a 10-km SSMF link with 16 bi-directional 10GE connections
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a real-time CPRI-over-Ethemet system for mobile fronthaul using four Xilinx Virtex-7 FPGAs. Error-free transmission over a 10-km SSMF link has been achieved with a total throughput of 120 Gb/s and a round-trip processing latency of <20 μs.

articleTitle: High efficient suspended coupler based on IME's MPW platform with 193nm lithography
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Benefiting from the new 193nm lithography, a narrow tip with width of 100 nm can be fabricated on IME's MPW platform. Based on the new capability, we optimized the suspended coupler and realized the state-of-the-art coupling loss less than -1.3 dB/facet with cleaved single mode fiber. A uniformity of 0.4 dB across wafers has also been confirmed, the best performance to our knowledge realized in public-available silicon photonics platform.

articleTitle: Impact of WDM channel count on nonlinear effects in MDM transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We vary the number of WDM channels and investigate the impact on the nonlinear effects in mode-division multiplexed transmissions. The OSNR requirements for 15 spatial modes and up to 80 WDM channels are evaluated.

articleTitle: Fast statistical estimation in highly compressed digital RoF systems for efficient 5G wireless signal delivery
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A fast data compression algorithm is proposed for wireless-signal delivery in a digital RoF system supporting mobile fronthaul. Combined with resampling and advanced modulation formats, data-transmission efficiency is improved by 5 times in experimental demonstrations.

articleTitle: Regeneration of noise limited frequency comb lines for 64-QAM by Brillouin gain seeded via SSB modulation
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate noise suppression for parametrically generated optical frequency comb-lines with low 10GHz-pitch by narrowband Brillouin amplification pumped self-seeded via single-sideband modulation (SSB). Comb-line carrier performance close to a reference laser is achieved for 96Gb/s-DP-64QAM.

articleTitle: 100 GBd intensity modulation and direct detection with an InP-based monolithic DFB laser Mach-Zehnder modulator
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time with a DFB-MZM at 1550 nm, 100-GBd NRZ and PAM4 transmission over up to 1.2 km due to close-to-zero chirp. At 100-GBd PAM4, the DFB-MZM consumed only 0.85 pJ/bit.

articleTitle: Impact of WSS passband narrowing effect on the capacity of the flexible-spectrum networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show that the WSS passband shape needs to be optimized to the 3.6<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> and 3.2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> Super-Gaussian orders in BT-UK and PAN-Europe networks, respectively, for realizing the 30% capacity increase promised by the flexible-spectrum standard.

articleTitle: Endlessly adiabatic fibre
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An optical fibre with a logarithmic index profile can be adiabatically tapered over any length, no matter how short. We report an experimental approximation to such a fibre.

articleTitle: Reproducible broadband optical noise generation based on phase modulation to intensity modulation conversion and a nonlinear transformation
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a reproducible broadband optical noise generation scheme. A flat spectrum and a symmetrical distribution can be obtained. The complexity of the analogue noise can be determined by the input binary sequence.

articleTitle: Automatic tuning and temperature stabilization of high-order silicon Vernier microring filters
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Using in-resonator photoconductive heaters to monitor and tune the light intensity inside the resonators, a four-ring Vernier filter is automatically tuned across the entire C-band and stabilized over a 40 °C temperature range.

articleTitle: >1-Tb/s on-board optical engine for high-density optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a >1-Tb/s VCSEL-based on-board optical engine for high-density optical interconnects. The optical engine integrates 28-Gb/s × 24-channel transmitter and receiver into one package of 1-inch<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> footprint. Hence, the total data rate is as high as 1.34 Tb/s. The thermal simulation is performed when operating all 24 channels with the total power of 9.1 W with CDR and 6.0 W without CDR, assuming an actual air-cooling environment. The optical engine can perform within the operating case temperature range at an ambient temperature of 40 °C and exhibit a good signal quality in a parallel loop-back link.

articleTitle: Large-scale silicon photonic switches using electro-optic MZIs
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review our recent progress on silicon photonic switches based on electro-optic MZI and dual-ring assisted MZI switch elements. Phase error corrections are performed using thermal tuning to set the initial switching state.

articleTitle: IM/DD transmission techniques for emerging 5G fronthaul, DCI and metro applications
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Our IM/DD techniques investigations are reviewed. Poly-binary is low complexity and good for the 5G fronthaul and DCI scenarios while DMT is suitable for metro transmission due to better bandwidth utilization and higher dispersion tolerance.

articleTitle: Design and demonstration of 30-nm tunable guard-band-less all-optical wavelength converter for WDM signals
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We design an all-optical wavelength converter enabling guard-band-less tunable operation over 30-nm bandwidth for WDM signals. Arbitrary conversion operations in 1530-1560nm range for 8-channel 32-Gbaud DP-QPSK signals with the bandwidth of 1THz are successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Ultimately low-loss and compact Si wire 90° waveguide bend composed of clothoid and normal curves for dense optical interconnect PICs
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Ultimately low-loss 90° waveguide bend composed of clothoid and normal curves is proposed for dense optical interconnect PICs. 90 % reduction of the bending loss is experimentally demonstrated with excellent agreement between theory and experiment.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 352 Gbit/s photonically-enabled D-band wireless delivery in one 2×2 MIMO system
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: First demonstration of photonically-enabled independent side-bands D-Band wireless transmission up to 352 Gbit/s with a BER below 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>. These results were achieved by means of advanced DSP and antenna polarization multiplexing (2×2 MIMO).

articleTitle: On-chip simultaneous multi-channel ultra-wideband radio frequency spectrum analyzer
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate how to harness mode-selective excitation of nonlinear optical effects to perform simultaneous multi-channel RF spectrum analysis for both 640 GHz and 160 GHz waveforms using a single integrated silicon photonic device.

articleTitle: Single-carrier 216 Gbit/s, 12 Gsymbol/s 512 QAM coherent transmission over 160 km with injection-locked homodyne detection
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a pol-mux, 12 Gsymbol/s 512 QAM coherent transmission. An injection-locked homodyne-detection circuit enabled precise optical-phase locking, and 216 Gbit/s-data were successfully transmitted over 160 km with a potential spectral efficiency of 12 bit/s/Hz.

articleTitle: Broadband optical amplifier for a wavelength region of 1515–1775 nm
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report the first demonstration of optical amplifier based on bismuth- and erbium-codoped germanosilicate fibers. The 15-dB small-signal gain window covers a 260-nm band by using a single-wavelength pumping at 1460 nm.

articleTitle: Techno-economic analysis of transmission technologies in low aggregation rings of metropolitan networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A techno-economic comparison of dark fiber and passive architectures to evolve low aggregation metro rings of 1G is presented. Results demonstrate that there are alternatives more cost-effective than just migrating to 10G.

articleTitle: WDM transmission of 16-channel single-carrier 128-GBaud PDM-16QAM signals with 6.06 b/s/Hz SE
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the WDM transmission of 16-channel single-carrier 1.024 Tb/s signals based on 128-GBaud all-ETDM PDM-16QAM signals over 320-km standard single-mode-fiber with EDFA-only amplification with joint transmitter and receiver-side signal processing.

articleTitle: Techniques for agile network re-optimization following traffic fluctuations
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We study the cost effectiveness of network re-optimization for both short-term traffic variations and long-term traffic growth. The presented re-optimization operation is effective in reducing equipment cost while curbing the increase of operational cost.

articleTitle: Adaptive stokes space based polarization demultiplexing for flexible UDWDM metro-access networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a flexible coherent UDWDM system with support to optical-wireless links and adaptive DP-QPSK/DP-16QAM modulation, enabled by Stokes-based polarization-demultiplexing. The system is shown to be resilient to dynamic power ranges of >12 dB.

articleTitle: Plenary session
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Provides an abstract of the presentation and a brief professional biography of the presenter. The complete presentation was not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: Ultra-fast ring-protection demonstration of fixed latency sub-wavelength granularity ethernet packet paths
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel ultra-fast and scalable ring-protection switching scheme is proposed and demonstrated for fixed latency Ethernet paths of sub-wavelength granularity. Protection in a seven node ring network is achieved within 712 μs.

articleTitle: Tailoring the response of stimulated Brillouin scattering in fibers
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Stimulated Brillouin scattering (SBS) limits the amount of light per unit bandwidth that can be transmitted down or generated in an optical fiber. As such, it typically has the lowest threshold of all the nonlinear processes in narrow line-width systems and is a major limitation in the scaling fiber lasers to higher powers. This paper describes how thoughtful consideration of the materials from which the fibers are made can have marked effects on SBS mitigation; more so than achievable through complex microstructuring of the optical fiber.

articleTitle: All-fiber optical interconnection for dissimilar multicore fibers with low insertion loss
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a novel approach for providing low-loss optical interconnection between multicore fibers having dissimilar core pitch. Using simple image formation by a graded index fiber lens a significant core pitch difference (36μm and 29μm) is compensated with low coupling loss (~1.5dB).

articleTitle: Correlated-failure-aware VON mapping
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We analyze the availability of virtual optical networks (VONs) mapped over a physical optical network with correlated failures, and we propose a correlated-failure-aware VON mapping algorithm to support high availability while reducing the penalty cost and total link cost.

articleTitle: Simultaneous measurement of temperature and strain based on a polarization-maintaining few-mode fiber
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An optical sensor based on a polarization-maintaining few-mode fiber (PM-FMF) for simultaneous sensing of temperature and strain is demonstrated, for the first time. The sensor has a temperature sensitivity of about 175 pm/°C and a strain sensitivity of about 5 pm/με with an accuracy of 0.1°C and 10 με.

articleTitle: Influence of lasers with non-white frequency noise on the design of coherent optical links
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate for a 28 Gbaud 64-QAM metro link that the LO frequency noise causes timing impairment. Results show the existence of LO frequency noise spectrum regimes where different design criteria apply.

articleTitle: Real-time 8×200-Gb/s 16-QAM unrepeatered transmission over 458.8 km using concatenated receiver-side ROPAs
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate real-time 8×200-Gb/s DP-16QAM transmission over a 458.8 km link assisted by one Tx-ROPA and two concatenated Rx-ROPAs. Compared with using only one Rx-ROPA, a 5 dB increase in total link loss was achieved.

articleTitle: 246 GHz digitally stitched coherent receiver
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Phase estimation and 4×2 MIMO equalization techniques are experimentally compared for digital frequency stitching in ultra-wideband coherent reception, using time multiplexing and a single conventional dual polarization coherent receiver, to simultaneously detect a 5×46GBaud super-channel.

articleTitle: Experimental study of nonlinearity tolerant modulation formats based on LDPC coded non-uniform signaling
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Nonlinearity tolerant 5-QAM and 9-QAM are experimentally studied for long-haul WDM transmission. Compared to QPSK and 8-QAM, the transmission reach is extended for 12% and 222% by using LDPC-coded non-uniform 5-QAM and 9-QAM, respectively.

articleTitle: Optical network as a service for service function chaining across datacenters
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present the SPN OS, a Network-as-a-Service orchestration platform for NFV/SDN integrated service provisioning across multiple datacenters over packet/optical networks. Our prototype showcases template-driven service function chaining and high-level network programming-based optical networking.

articleTitle: Record high capacity (6.8 Tbit/s) WDM coherent transmission in hollow-core antiresonant fiber
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The first multi-terabit/s WDM data transmission through anti-resonant hollow-core fiber is demonstrated. 16×32-GBd dual-polarization Nyquist-shaped 256QAM channels propagated through a 270-m long fiber. No non-linearity penalty was observed for powers up to 1W.

articleTitle: Dual laser switching for dynamic wavelength operation in amplified optical transmission
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Fast switching of a dual laser PM-QPSK transceiver is used to mitigate channel-power excursions in amplified optical transmission under wavelength reconfiguration.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of tunable optical channel slicing and stitching to enable dynamic bandwidth allocation
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A tunable optical channel slicing and stitching scheme is experimentally demonstrated in QPSK/16QAM systems. Its application to dynamic bandwidth allocation in WDM channels brings >6dB OSNR improvement at 1e-3 BER comparing to direct channel insertion.

articleTitle: Scrambling-type three-mode multiplexer based on cascaded Y-branch waveguide with integrated mode rotator on PLC platform
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel scrambling-type mode multiplexer is proposed for future large-mode-number mode-division-multiplexing. 3-mode multiplexer design based on silica PLC shows low-loss and small wavelength dependence multiplexing is possible and a proof-of-concept device is fabricated.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband optical signal processing using AlGaAs-OI devices
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Aluminum Gallium Arsenide on insulator (AlGaAs-OI) has recently been developed into a very attractive platform for optical signal processing. This paper reviews key results of broadband optical signal processing using this platform.

articleTitle: Novel a-Si on garnet nonreciprocal phase shift optical isolator with TE mode operation
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A waveguide optical isolator operating in TE mode was demonstrated with an isolation of 17.9 dB. Amorphous silicon core along lateral walls of magneto-optical garnet was fabricated to induce nonreciprocal phase shift in TE mode.

articleTitle: Single channel 106 Gbit/s 16QAM wireless transmission in the 0.4 THz band
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a single channel 32-GBd 16QAM THz wireless link operating in the 0.4 THz band. Post-FEC net data rate of 106 Gbit/s is successfully achieved without any spatial/frequency multiplexing.

articleTitle: Super-resolution spectral reconstruction for DWDM channel monitoring
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a super-resolution algorithm to estimate channel power and spacing. We show minimal loss in power accuracy and frequency accuracy 1000× below the spectrometer resolution.

articleTitle: Novel intra- and inter-datacenter converged network exploiting space- and wavelength-dimensional switches
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a novel network architecture that enables intra- and inter-datacenter converged flow management. By adopting our proposed single large-scale optical circuit switch, intra- and inter-datacenter traffic can be transported without any blocking.

articleTitle: Low power consumption and high-speed Ge receivers
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A new Si/Ge/Si heterojunction based waveguide photodetector has been demonstrated in order to reduce the fabrication cost, increase the responsivity, and improve process robustness. State of the art characteristics in terms of dark current, responsivity and bandwidth have been obtained. Furthermore, such photodetectors were characterized in avalanche mode in order to improve the sensitivity and reduce the overall power consumption of the optical circuit.

articleTitle: Fast DAC solutions for future high symbol rate systems
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We review electronic digital-to-analog converter (DAC) technologies with sampling rates beyond 200 GSa/s and analog electrical bandwidths of 100 GHz using digital bandwidth interleaving. These allow the all-electronic generation of up to 195-GBaud electrical and 180-Gbaud optical modulation formats.

articleTitle: Benefits of programmability in 5G transport networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper shows how programmability can improve operators' revenues and it presents a dynamic resource slicing policy that leads to more than one order of magnitude better resource utilization levels than convectional (static) allocation strategies.

articleTitle: Over 40 Gb/s dynamic bidirectional all-optical indoor wireless communication using photonic integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel all-optical system using optical cross-connect and reflective modulator photonic chips to realize bidirectional dynamic indoor wireless networks equipped with localization and tracking functionalities, with over 40 Gb/s data capacity per user.

articleTitle: Design of softwarized EPON OLT and its transmission jitter suppression techniques over MPCP
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Softwarized-OLT is expect to realize flexible and cost-effective PON systems but the large transmission jitter of gate messages caused by computing process is critical for MPCP. Thus, we propose and evaluate jitter suppression DBA techniques.

articleTitle: Dynamic control of coarse/fine hybrid granular routing optical networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Dynamic control of coarse/fine granular routing optical networks is proposed. The routing scheme exploits virtual direct links, which enhances fiber frequency utilization and eliminates the need to control intermediate nodes. Its effectiveness is numerically verified.

articleTitle: 4 × 56 Gb/s high output power electroabsorption modulated laser array
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a high output power EML-array operating at 4 × 56 Gb/s NRZ. On chip RF transmission lines enable flexibility for packaging and driver integration. A common active layer structure allows for cost effective fabrication.

articleTitle: Energy saving in SBPP-based IP over WDM networks with protection router card sleeping
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We develop an energy-saving scheme for the shared backup path protected (SBPP) IP over WDM network through sleeping protection router cards. Results show that the scheme is efficient and reduces energy consumption significantly compared to other conventional schemes.

articleTitle: IM-DD MDM-WDM transmission over 120-km weakly-coupled FMF enabled by wavelength interleaving
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Wavelength-interleaved (WI) scheme is proposed to mitigate modal crosstalk during weakly-coupled few-mode fiber (FMF) transmission, based on which 2×3×10-Gb/s IM-DD MDM-WDM transmission over 120-km 2-mode FMF without MIMO processing has been experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of Raman-assisted phase sensitive amplifier with reduced ASE noise level and more than 25dB net gain
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The performance of a black-box Raman-assisted PSA amplifier is experimentally evaluated. In a 20-Gbaud QPSK system, more than 25dB net gain is demonstrated. Comparing to a 4dB-noise-figure EDFA, ∼1.5dB ASE noise level reduction is observed.

articleTitle: Kramers-Kronig PAM transceiver
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a new transceiver scheme using PAM transmission in combination with direct detection and digital reconstruction of the optical phase. This allows digital compensation of chromatic dispersion and provides a significant improvement in terms of spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Spatial pulse position modulation for multi-mode transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A spatial pulse position modulation is proposed and experimentally validated for a 12 spatial channel transmission over 53km multi-mode fiber. Improved data rates up to 30% are demonstrated with respect to conventional QPSK.

articleTitle: First demonstration of an all analog adaptive equalizer for coherent DP-QPSK links
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: For the first time, an all analog CMA equalizer for DP-QPSK transmission systems has been demonstrated. The experiment with an 8-Gb/s link shows promise for low power analog processing based receivers for short-reach DP-QPSK links.

articleTitle: Optically generated single side-band radio-over-fiber transmission of 60Gbit/s over 50m at W-band
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 60Gbit/s single side-band multi-band CAP radio-over-fiber transmission at W-band is demonstrated. A spectral efficiency of 3.8bit/s/Hz and bit error rates below 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> are achieved after 50m wireless transmission.

articleTitle: Exploiting time-synchronized operations in software-defined elastic optical networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and discuss NETCONF / OpenFlow implementations of time-synchronized operations, recently standardized in SDN, to minimize disruption time during lightpath reassignment in Elastic Optical Networks. 75% disruption time reduction is reported in our test scenario.

articleTitle: Multi-channel, widely-tunable coherent transmitter and receiver PICs operating at 88Gbaud/16-QAM
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate 2-channel Tx and Rx PICs capable of delivering >700Gbps per channel (via 88Gbaud, 16-QAM dual-polarization modulation) over an 80km unamplified link with per channel extended C-band tunability.

articleTitle: Signal overlap for efficient 1+1 protection in elastic optical networks (EONs)
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: An innovative transmission technique enabling signal overlap is introduced for spectrally-efficient 1+1 protection. Simulation results show that the proposed technique successfully reduces the overall amount of occupied spectrum resources.

articleTitle: Fast reconfigurable SOA-based all-optical wavelength conversion of QPSK data employing switching tunable pump lasers
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a dynamically reconfigurable SOA-based all-optical wavelength convertor for QPSK data at 12.5 GBuad using a fast switching tunable laser as one of the pump sources. The experimental results indicate that it is feasible to build fast reconfigurable wavelength convertors with <;30 ns switching time.

articleTitle: Capacity limits for free-space channels
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We show that OAM multiplexing does not realize the capacity limits of free-space channels, and is outperformed by multiplexing in parallel Gaussian beams or any complete modal basis.

articleTitle: Fully integrated non-duplicate polarization-diversity 8 × 8 Si-wire PILOSS switch
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a polarization-diversity 8×8 thermo-optic Si-wire switch that uses only a single PILOSS switch matrix integrated with polarization splitter-rotators. A PDL of 2 dB and DGD of 1.5 ps are achieved in C-band.

articleTitle: Broadband wavelength filter device using a sidewall grating in multimode SOI Rib waveguide
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A filter device with a flat-top passband of Δλ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pb</sub> > 40 nm is demonstrated using multi-mode SOI waveguide with a side-wall grating. The passband is bounded by highly extinguished sidebands of Δλ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sb</sub> > 10 nm.

articleTitle: Early pre-FEC BER degradation detection to meet committed QoS
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Early optical layer BER degradation detection is proposed to trigger affected demands re-routing, targeting at reducing SLA violation. Results show that the proposed detection and re-routing algorithms noticeably reduce bandwidth and number of demands affected.

articleTitle: Digital subcarrier multiplexing in optically routed networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We examine the benefit of digital subcarrier multiplexing in optically routed networks. We show that optimizing the number of subcarriers not only improves system tolerance to nonlinearities, but also induces smaller performance variations in various network scenarios.

articleTitle: Temperature dependent analysis of 50 Gb/s oxide-confined VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Temperature dependent analysis of a high speed 850 nm oxide-confined VCSEL with 50 Gb/s error-free capability and a -3 dB modulation bandwidth of 24.7 GHz at 85 °C is reported.

articleTitle: Low-complexity embedded BICM-ID structure for multi-dimensional coded modulation
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A low-complexity BICM-ID structure which embeds demappers inside the iterative FEC decoder is proposed and demonstrated. 0.47-dB SNR gain over BICM can be obtained for the 8-dimentional modulation format with 8.5-miUion extra ASIC gates at 100-Gb/s throughput.

articleTitle: 42.3-Tbit/s, 18-Gbaud 64QAM WDM coherent transmission of 160 km over full C-band using an injection locking technique with a spectral efficiency of 9 bit/s/Hz
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a 235-channel WDM 18-Gbaud 64QAM coherent transmission of 160 km over the full C-band with a new homodyne detection technique using injection locking. 42.3-Tbit/s data were successfully transmitted with a 9-bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Introducing the fast inverse NFT
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In optical fiber communication, the nonlinear frequency division multiplexing scheme requires a fast inverse nonlinear Fourier transform (NFT). We present two algorithms with O (N(K + log<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> N)) complexity for N samples of a signal comprising K eigenvalues.

articleTitle: Bit-parallel all-to-all and flexible AWGR-based optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: This paper demonstrates bit-parallel, all-to-all communication with AWGR for on-board optical interconnects. A flexible bandwidth allocation is also presented. Trade-off studies optimize the bit-parallelism and achieve up to 3.5× higher energy efficiency compared to the single-bit case.

articleTitle: Schottky diodes in 40nm bulk CMOS for 1310nm high-speed optical receivers
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this paper, the use of Schottky diodes in CMOS as 1310nm photodetectors is proposed. In contrast with regular pn-diodes, these diodes can convert photons with a wavelength longer than 1.1 μm to a high bandwidth current through internal photo emission. Distributed layout n-well and p-well Schottky diodes have been fabricated and characterized in 40nm bulk CMOS. The measured 1310nm DC responsivity for the n-well and p-well Schottky diodes is 0.4mA/W and 0.35A/W respectively for 1V reverse bias. To the authors' knowledge, this is the first 1310nm CMOS photodetector reported.

articleTitle: Extra penalty when fitting the filtering bandwidth of successive traversed WSS's to a lower channel symbol rate
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate with a real time Baud rate agile transponder, the OSNR penalty on a signal traversing several WSS's the filtering bandwidths of which are set proportionally to the symbol rate for optimal spectral utilization.

articleTitle: Long-reach MMWoF using single-sideband modulated dual-mode VCSEL with 16-QAM OFDM at 8 Gbit/s
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 39-GHz millimeter-wave-over-fiber (MMWoF) based long-reach PON with a dual-mode VCSEL transmitter under single-sideband modulation is demonstrated for 8-Gbit/s 16-QAM OFDM transmission over 50-km single-mode fiber and 1-m free-space with BER of 3.6×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>.

articleTitle: Athermal operation of a multi-section laser for optical communications
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Two distinct athermal bias current control procedures are demonstrated for a low-cost, monolithic, three section slotted single mode laser, achieving wavelength stability of ±0.01 nm over a temperature range of 10–85°C. This is the first time that athermal performance has been demonstrated for a three-section slotted laser with simple fabrication, and has possible applications in low-cost, ONU-side PON applications. An analytical model provides further insight into the operation of these devices.

articleTitle: Distributed vs. centralized PCE-based transport SDN controller for flexi-grid optical networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We validate the use of a centralized PCE architecture as an SDN controller to compute and configure flexi-grid optical networks. Besides presenting new PCEP extensions, performance evaluation compares PCE-based solution with traditional distributed signaling approach.

articleTitle: Cost-effective next-generation information highways leveraging universal OTN switching and flexible-rate
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Current trend of data growth and revenue pattern make multi-layer network technology and architecture selection critical. This paper highlights how combining universal OTN switching and flexi-rate line interfaces can outperform traditional technologies in minimizing CAPEX.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband EA-DFB laser module for 200-Gbit/s PAM4 transmitter
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A lumped-electrode EA-DFB laser module with a modulation bandwidth of ∼59 GHz was designed and fabricated based on a flip-chip interconnection technique. It enables 107-Gbaud PAM4 transmission.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of a period-one (P1) nonlinear dynamic modulated optical OFDM signal employing to a millimeter wave (MMW) mobile fronthaul uplink
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: For the first time, a period-one (P1) nonlinear dynamic modulated MMW OFDM signal is employed to mobile fronthaul uplink. A proof-of-concept experimental demonstrations show successfully retrieved signals after 1.5-m wireless and 25-km SMF transmissions.

articleTitle: Mode-dependent gain characterization of erbium-doped multimode fiber using C2 imaging
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We characterize the mode profiles, delays and mode-dependent gains of an erbium-doped step-index multimode fiber using C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> imaging based on a swept-wavelength interferometer. Space-to-time mapping is used to reduce measurement time.

articleTitle: Benefits of higher modulation in flexible grid networks using optical WDM and digital OTN switching
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We study the effects of higher modulation formats on the design of optical network architectures using Flexible Grid and Sliceable Bandwidth Variable Transponders. We show architectures with digital switching getting more benefit from higher modulation.

articleTitle: Ultra-low DMG multimode EDFA
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate amplification in a multimode cladding-pumped fiber amplifier supporting 36 spatial modes. Using a large core EDF, we obtain <;0.5dB differential modal gain, 16dB gain, and 25dBm output power across the C-band.

articleTitle: A framework for dynamic multi-layer resource allocation and optimization in application-centric networking
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In an SDN-based network, connection requests can be accommodated according to application requirements. We devise a framework where such requirements drive IP and optical network resource allocation, dynamic optimization, and instantiation through an SDN orchestrator.

articleTitle: Mobile fronthaul architecture and technologies: A RAN equipment assessment
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optical fiber is the required technology for Radio Access Network (RAN) backhaul and fronthaul. We report the evolution of RAN equipment including the advent of virtualization and an investigation of the required architecture and optical access technologies.

articleTitle: W-band 16QAM-modulated SSB photonic vector Mm-wave signal generation by one single I/Q modulator
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Adopting asymmetrical-single-sideband-modulation enabled by one single I/Q modulator, we experimentally demonstrate a novel scheme for photonic generation of W-band 16QAM-modulated photonic vector mm-wave signal, which can be transmitted over 80-km SMF-28 without optical dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Do elastic transponders with granularity finer than 50 Gb/s make gradual fit of modulation to ageing more profitable?
