publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a 64 Gb/s PAM-4 transimpedance amplifier with 180 mW power consumption. By switching between four gain modes, modulation amplitudes between -7 and at least -0.2 dBm yield a BER lower than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>.

articleTitle: Black phosphorus-coated tilted fiber Bragg grating for ultrasensitive ion sensing
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose an ultrasensitive ion sensor based on black phosphorus coated 81°-tilted fiber grating for Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> ion detection, demonstrating significant performance of ultrahigh sensitivity (8.6×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> dB/ppb), lower detection limit (0.4ppb) and wider concentration range (0.1ppb ~1.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> ppb).

articleTitle: Advanced technologies for high capacity transoceanic distance transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We discuss possible techniques for realizing higher capacity transoceanic transmission systems and outline the important role of wide bandwidth amplification using C+L EDFAs, nonlinear transmission optimization, space division multiplexing, advanced modulation formats, and variable spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Intra-datacenter links exploiting PCI express generation 4 interconnections
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate few-km reaches for PCIe-based optical fiber interconnections according to latency limitations, characterizing 16-Gb/s per lane Generation4 up to 10 km and confirming the Generation3 compliance of 2-km links employing suitable PCIe cards.

articleTitle: Investigation of optical impacts on virtualization using SDN-enabled transceiver and optical monitoring
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a scheme to introduce real-time optical layer monitoring into optical network virtualization enabled by software defined networking. The optical layer factors that impact the virtualization are characterised and investigated using this scheme experimentally.

articleTitle: Correlation properties of the phase noise between pairs of lines in a quantum-dot optical frequency comb source
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The correlation properties of the phase noise between pairs of comb lines are determined for a quantum-dot frequency comb source laser through simultaneous measurements of the in-phase and quadrature components for each of the comb lines.

articleTitle: Optical coherent transmission of 20×192-MHz DOCSIS 3.1 channels with 16384QAM based on delta-sigma digitization
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrated delta-sigma digitization and 80-km coherent transmission of 20×192-MHz DOCSIS 3.1 channels via a low-cost single-wavelength DP-16QAM system. Modulation-error-ratio higher than 48 dB was achieved supporting 16384QAM on all 20 DOCSIS channels.

articleTitle: Suppression of burst-mode operation induced laser wavelength drift for upstream transmission in TWDM-PON by using an integrated heater for thermal control
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate substantial suppression of the wavelength drift of a 10-Gb/s burst-mode directly-modulated laser for TWDM-PON upstream transmission by using an integrated heater for thermal compensation, reducing the drift by 4.6 times to 5 GHz.

articleTitle: Optical nonlinearity mitigation of 6 χ 10 GBd polarization-division multiplexing 16 QAM signals in a field-installed transmission link
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report nonlinear impairment mitigation of PDM 16 QAM WDM signals through mid-link optical phase conjugation in a 834km-long installed fiber link. Efficient reuse of signal bandwidth and Q-factor improvements of up to 3 dB are demonstrated.

articleTitle: EVM reduction in digital mobile fronthaul by sample bits interleaving and uneven PAM4
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a digital MFH system exploiting sample bits interleaving and uneven PAM4. Digitized LTE-A signal transmission is experimentally demonstrated via 25Gbps fiber link. The results indicate that, ~13dB EVM reduction can be achieved, compared with evenly-spaced PAM4.

articleTitle: Impact of damping on 50 Gbps 4-PAM modulation of 25G class VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate the effects of photon lifetime and damping of the modulation response on the quality of 50 Gbps 4-PAM signal generation with directly modulated 25G class VCSELs and identify the appropriate values for the K-factor.

articleTitle: Capacity limits of space-division multiplexed submarine links subject to nonlinearities and power feed constraints
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We compute the capacity limits of space-division multiplexed submarine links. We demonstrate that limitations due to nonlinearities become negligible compared to power-feed limitations as the propagation distance and the total number of spatial channels increase.

articleTitle: InP integrated photonics: State of the art and future directions
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: InP integrated circuits enable transceiver technologies with more than 200Gb/s per wavelength and 2Tb/s per fiber. Advances in monolithic integration are poised to reduce energy, remove assembly complexity, and sustain future year-on-year performance increases.

articleTitle: Experimental estimation of optical nonlinear memory channel conditional distribution using deep neural networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate that neural networks can approximate the conditional distribution of non-linear channels with memory. This distribution then feeds the BCJR algorithm to detect transmitted data in experimental IM/DD 3.2-km transmission of 64 GBd PAM4.

articleTitle: On the impact of probabilistic shaping on SNR and information rates in multi-span WDM systems
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Numerical simulations and the EGN model show that probabilistic shaping decreases SNR due to modulation-dependent nonlinear effects. This SNR loss, however, is less important than the rate increase from shaping, resulting in an overall gain.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband tunable fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the ultra-broadband gain medium exploiting cascaded Raman amplification. Pumping the 5-km long linear cavity fiber laser at 1349 nm we show the tunability of the laser operation from 1400 to 1622 nm.

articleTitle: Broadband plasmonic modulator enabling single carrier operation beyond 100 Gbit/s
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a plasmonic Mach-Zehnder modulator with a flat frequency response exceeding 170 GHz. Modulation of the device is shown at 100 GBd NRZ and 60 GBd PAM-4.

articleTitle: Network synthesis of a topology reconfigurable disaggregated rack scale datacentre for multi-tenancy
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A performance analysis of a hybrid reconfigurable disaggregated datacentre is presented. It offers substantial benefits in terms of network blocking, power consumption and cost when compared to pure circuit switched and statistical hybrid architectures.

articleTitle: Optical fronthauling for 5G mobile: A perspective of passive metro WDM technology
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We discuss the necessity of passive WDM technology in the 5G fronthaul application. The proof-of-concept field trial showed that the proposed system integrated seamlessly with the current wireless equipment and had no impact on services.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of performance-enhanced MIMO-OFDM visible light communications
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate individual OCT precoding and SVD-based adaptive loading to boost the capacity of MIMO-OFDM VLC systems. For 1.5-Gbit/s 1-m transmission, the average BER can be reduced from 1.7×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> to 4.1 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> and 4.7×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>, respectively.

articleTitle: Microprocessor chip with photonic I/O
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this work, we provide an overview of the technology and architecture of a microprocessor chip with optical I/O. Zero-change photonics integration enabled the chip to be fabricated in a commercial electronics CMOS foundry.

articleTitle: Real-time 200 Gb/s (4×56.25 Gb/s) PAM-4 transmission over 80 km SSMF using quantum-dot laser and silicon ring-modulator
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report real-time 4×56.26-Gb/s DWDM PAM-4 transmission over 80-km SSMF with novel optical transmitter sub-assembly comprising multi-wavelength quantum-dot laser and silicon ring modulators. Pre-FEC BERs below 1E-4 are achieved after 80-km, allowing error-free operation with HD-FEC.

articleTitle: Performance improvement of electronic dispersion post-compensation in direct detection systems using DSP-based receiver linearization
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Significant improvements in the performance of electronic dispersion post-compensation enabled by beating interference compensation were experimentally demonstrated in a 112 Gb/s/λ WDM Nyquist-subcarrier modulation direct-detection system in transmission over distances up to 240 km.

articleTitle: 300-km Transmission of dispersion pre-compensated PAM4 using direct modulation and direct detection
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 20-Gbit/s PAM4 signal was generated by directly modulating two injection-locked Fabry-Perot lasers. Our transmitter can control the full field of the optical signal and achieved error-free transmission over 300-km SMF-28.

articleTitle: Real-time path monitoring of optical nodes
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel method for monitoring internal paths of optical nodes exploiting light labeling technique. The optical paths of a 2×2 wavelength cross connect could be monitored in 2ms without affecting transmission performance.

articleTitle: Amplifier-less transmission of 56Gbit/s PAM4 over 60km using 25Gbps EML and APD
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this paper, we experimentally demonstrated 56Gbit/s PAM4 signal optical amplifier-less transmissions over a record distance 60km using 25Gbps EML and APD. Compared to PD-based receiver, improvements of 7dB and 50% in terms of receiver sensitivity and transmission distance were achieved.

articleTitle: Simple geometric approach for optimization of phase-sensitive fibre optic parametric amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate application of a simple design method - geometric approach for optimization of the performance of phase-sensitive fiber optical parametric amplifier.

articleTitle: Experimental characterization of submarine "open cable" using Gaussian-noise model and OSNRwet parameter
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: With the coherent era, a new parameter called OSNRwet is experimentally studied for "open cable" characterization. A +/-0.3dB maximum deviation from the average is found for 3 modulation formats, 3 channel spacings and 3 distances.

articleTitle: Nonlinear equalizer for 112-Gb/s SSB-PAM4 in 80-km dispersion uncompensated link
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a blindly adaptive nonlinear channel equalizer that effectively compensates nonlinearity in SSB-PAM4 transceiver components. The proposed scheme is demonstrated over 56GBaud PAM4 transmission over 80km dispersion uncompensated link with low BER near 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>.

articleTitle: Fiber random grating feedback induced chaos in semiconductor laser with highly suppressed time-delay signature
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A semiconductor laser with distributed feedbacks from a novel fiber random grating is perturbed to emit chaotically. The time delay signature of the chaotic output is suppressed with the largest extent to date.

articleTitle: 50GBd 64APSK coded modulation transmission over long haul submarine distance with nonlinearity compensation and subcarrier multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We achieve transoceanic distance transmission with 350-390 Gb/s 64APSK coded modulation channels and explore the benefit of nonlinearity compensation with subcarrier multiplexing. Estimated total capacity with variable spectral efficiency is 66.8 Tb/s.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of LTE-A M×4×4 MIMO radio-over-multicore fiber fronthaul
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The carrier aggregation support in a 3GPP 2×4×4 MIMO LTE-Advanced optical MCF fronthaul is proposed and demonstrated experimentally. The optical power margin between cores transmitting MIMO is evaluated to be 5dB better than SISO configuration.

articleTitle: A Bayesian-based approach for virtual network reconfiguration in elastic optical path networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We investigate a Bayesian approach for VN reconfiguration in elastic optical networks. The approach identifies traffic condition from simple observations and selects VN suitable to the condition. Results show a fast converge of VN reconfiguration.

articleTitle: Low-cost visible light communication system based on off-the-shelf LED for up to 4.3 Gb/s/λ transmission
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Multi-Gb/s/λ visible light communication is demonstrated using a commodity LED rated for 150 Mb/s and OFDM/Nyquist-FDM with 256-QAM sub-carrier modulation. lGb/s/λ throughput and real-time video streaming is achieved over 10dB optical budget and PIN receiver.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of nonlinearity mitigation properties of a hybrid distributed Raman/phase-sensitive amplifier link
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The first experimental demonstration of a long-haul transmission system utilizing both phase-sensitive amplifiers and distributed Raman amplification is presented. The impact of the span power map in a nonlinear transmission regime is investigated.

articleTitle: High bit-rate distance product of 128 Gbps.km 4-PAM transmission over 2-km OM4 fiber using an 850-nm VCSEL and a Volterra nonlinear equalizer
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We successfully demonstrate a 64-Gbps 4-PAM transmission over 2-km OM4 fiber incorporating a Volterra equalizer with BER of 6.5 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>. Record high bit-rate distance product of 128 Gbps·km is confirmed for optical-interconnect applications.

articleTitle: Single-channel 3.84 Tbit/s, 64 QAM coherent Nyquist pulse transmission over 150 km with frequency-stabilized and mode-locked laser
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a polarization-multiplexed 320 Gbaud, 64 QAM coherent optical Nyquist pulse transmission with a frequency-stabilized mode-locked laser. Single-channel 3.84 Tbit/s data were successfully transmitted over 150 km with a spectral efficiency of 10.6 bit/s/Hz.

articleTitle: On the use of GMI to compare advanced modulation formats
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A variety of advanced modulation formats, including set-partitioning M-QAM, time-hybrid QAM, multi-dimensional formats, geometric- and probabilistic-shaped constellation, are compared by means of GMI metric.

articleTitle: 1-Pb/s (32 SDM/46 WDM/768 Gb/s) C-band dense SDM transmission over 205.6-km of single-mode heterogeneous multi-core fiber using 96-Gbaud PDM-16QAM channels
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We demonstrate the first 1-Pb/s unidirectional inline-amplified transmission over 205.6-km of single-mode 32-core fiber within C-band only. 96-Gbaud LDPC-coded PDM-16QAM channels with FEC redundancy of 12.75% realize high-aggregate spectral efficiency of 217.6 b/s/Hz.

articleTitle: SDN/NFV futures: Moving beyond initial deployments
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We provide a brief overview of Verizon's initial SDN/NFV deployments and then describe future directions being evaluated and implemented to expand the SDN/NFV infrastructure's usefullness. We will discuss ideas for implementing performance-sensitive VNFs, to include optical network elements, and using SDN/NFV to improve infrastructure security.

articleTitle: Few-mode 850-nm VCSEL chip with direct 16-QAM OFDM encoding at 80-Gbit/s for 100-m OM4 MMF link
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Chip-level direct 16-QAM OFDM encoding of a few-transverse-mode 850-nm Zn-diffused VCSEL is employed to transmit 80-Gbit/s data covering 20-GHz analog bandwidth over 100-m-long OM4 MMF with corresponding BER of 3.3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>.

articleTitle: Bio-inspired optical microwave phase lock loop based on nonlinear effects in semiconductor optical amplifier
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Optical microwave phase lock loop using semiconductor optical amplifiers is experimentally demonstrated. Bio-inspired by Eigenmannia and implemented with photonics, the proposed scheme is compact, has a simple architecture, and has a wide operating frequency range.

articleTitle: Open and disaggregated multi-layer networks
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Disaggregation of both packet and optical networks is driving innovation in transport networks. We demonstrate a proof of concept and detail our plans for a field trial in a major service provider.

articleTitle: TDECQ (transmitter dispersion eye closure quaternary) replaces historic eye-mask and TDP test for 400 Gb/s PAM4 optical transmitters
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: For PAM4 transmission in 400 Gb/s Datacom networks, use of equalization and FEC, and a need to reduce cost, force a replacement of historic eye-mask and TDP tests. We describe that replacement: TDECQ.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a packaged photonic integrated network on chip controlled by an FPGA-based scheduler
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: The dynamic performance of a packaged photonic network-on-chip (NoC) based on multi-microrings is experimentally demonstrated. Controlled by a scheduler implemented in an FPGA, the packaged photonic NoC exhibits a BER penalty of approximately 0.5 dB.

articleTitle: High-spectral efficiency DWDM transmission of 100-Gbit/s/lambda IM/DD single sideband-baseband-Nyquist-PAM8 signals
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: 107.52-Gbit/s SSB-Nyquist-PAM8 signaling is realized for the first time, achieving high-spectral efficiency of 4.30 bit/s/Hz (net SE 3.58), with intensity-modulation and polarization-independent conventional direct-detection and the longest 80-km SSMF transmission of PAM8 signals.

articleTitle: In-service location of multiple fiber faults in WDM/SCM-PONs with low-frequency stepwise sweep and l1 regularization
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We present a monitoring technique that can be directly integrated in the transceiver for WDM/SCM-PON applications. It is based on the detection of the backscattered signal from a baseband tone and interpretation with the LASSO operator for multiple fault detection.

articleTitle: Silicon nitride tri-layer 1×3 couplers with arbitrary splitting ratio for 3D photonic integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We design tri-layer Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> 1×3 couplers with arbitrary power splitting ratio and small reflection for 3D photonic integrated circuits. We demonstrate the power splitting ratio from 1:1:4 to 1:22:27 with 0.185 dB excess loss.

articleTitle: Coherent radio-over-fiber THz communication link for high data-rate 59 Gbit/s 64-QAM-OFDM and real-time HDTV transmission
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We report a coherent Radio-over-Fiber (CRoF) THz communication link supporting both, off-line high data-rate 59 Gbit/s transmission using a record spectral efficient 64-QAM-OFDM modulation as well as real-time HDTV transmission at 328 GHz carrier frequency.

articleTitle: Fully-parallel soft-decision cycle slip recovery
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: We propose a parallel cycle slip recovery method employing soft-decision slip-state estimation at pilots. Through mutual information analysis, we show that the proposed method achieves 0.6 dB gain in the presence of frequent cycle slips and strong phase noise.

articleTitle: Polarimetry of polarization-modulated signals based on polarization-selective RF power detection
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A novel Polarimeter identifies the main polarization axes of polarization-modulated, nominally unpolarized signals such as PDM-QPSK, PDM-QAM, PS-QPSK. It measures the electrical AC power detected behind several polarization analyzers and calculates the axes iteratively.

articleTitle: Optical spectrum analysis with a resolution of 6 fm based on a frequency-swept microwave-photonic source
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: A full-polarization optical spectrum analyzer is proposed based on a frequency-swept microwave-photonic source and balanced photodetection. A resolution of 0.75 MHz (6 fm) and a dynamic range of >57 dB were experimentally achieved.

articleTitle: Recent advances in short reach systems
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: In this paper, we review recent advances in high speed optical short reach transmission systems. Recent progress on advanced modulation formats, DSP, transmission schemes and devices are discussed.

articleTitle: Low-loss splice of large effective area fiber using fluorine-doped cladding standard effective area fiber
publicationTitle: 2017 Optical Fiber Communications Conference and Exhibition (OFC)
abstract: Ultra-low dissimilar splice loss of 0.08dB between Aeff-enlarged fiber (148μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) and standard Aeff fiber (83μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) was realized, by applying a ring core profile to Aeff-enlarged fiber and fluorine doped cladding to standard Aeff fiber.
